notes:
{半分|はんぶん} means 'half' as a noun, representing one of two equal parts.

COMPONENTS:
- {半|はん}: half
- {分|ぶん}: portion, part

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {半分|はんぶん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧ (to cut in half)
- {半分|はんぶん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{分|わ}ける→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧ (to divide in half)
- {半分|はんぶん}⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧ (half each)
- {半分|はんぶん}くらい (about half)
- {半分|はんぶん}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{残|のこ}っていない→残る：01187_nokoru⟧ (not even half remains)

RELATED COMPOUNDS WITH {半|はん}:
- ⟦{半額|はんがく}→半額：09546_hangaku⟧: half price
- ⟦{半年|はんとし}→半年：03139_hantoshi⟧: half a year, six months
- {半日|はんにち}: half a day
- {半数|はんすう}: half the number
- ⟦{半径|はんけい}→半径：04331_hankei⟧: radius (half diameter)
- ⟦{半島|はんとう}→半島：04333_hantou⟧: peninsula (half island)

CONTRAST:
- {半分|はんぶん}: half (noun - the half portion itself)
- {半|はん}: half (prefix - attaches to other words)
- {二分|にぶん}の{一|いち}: one-half (fractional expression)
